hosting.//build: dist is BUILT from public by `node tests/build-dist.js` (comments out, nothing renamed) — edit public/index.html, build, then deploy. Deploying public itself works too but ships 0.65 MB of comments.
hosting.//: THE PAGE ITSELF IS NEVER SERVED FROM CACHE WITHOUT ASKING FIRST. Hosting's default is max-age=3600, so a deployed fix could sit invisible for an hour and a tab left open kept running yesterday's code — which is how a sync ran this morning with the old rules and wrote order rows without their Shopify photos. no-cache does not mean 'do not cache': the browser keeps the file and revalidates, so an unchanged page still comes back as a 304 and costs nothing. Pictures and the wordmark keep their long cache; they change with a new name, not in place.
